newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Breweries Q3 profits higher.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Breweries Q3 profits higher.

text.p: Turnover and after-tax profit at the country's leading brewer, Nigerian Breweries improved in the third quarter to end-September from a year earlier, a senior company official said on Thursday.
Bright Ogbebor, company secretary, said in a statement made available at the Nigerian stock exchange that turnover for the period rose to 7,595 million naira from 6,769 million naira in 1995.

The after-tax profit was 925 million naira compared to 843 million naira in the corresponding third quarter of last year, he said, adding that profit before taxation was 1,542 million naira against 1,532 million in the corresponding of 1995.
"We are expecting the profit after tax for the full year to be same as that of 1995 nevertheless."
"The company is acting cautiously in the light of its recent experience which saw a run on its shares until a few weeks ago," one dealer said.
The company's share price rose 20 kobo in reaction to the results, ending at 15.20 naira on Thursday.
Nigerian Breweries recently trimmed its staff strength and acquired the franchise to bottle the Schweppes range of soft drinks in the bid to boost profits.
It also expanded to a large scale the production of its non-alcoholic malt drinks.
